parameters.image: A directly supplied picture. The child takes precedence when both are given.
parameters.child: Custom picture content, using the same frame as a photo.
parameters.glyph: The piece's sign, drawn in place of a photograph.
parameters.aspect: The width divided by the height of the media or placeholder.
parameters.semanticLabel: The text identifying this item or control.
parameters.fit: How the image is fitted into its allotted area.
parameters.alignment: Which part of the image remains visible when cropped.
parameters.width: Sets the width of the media frame.
